items.title: Swipe, Plug-in, Pwned: Researchers Find New Ways to Hack Vehicles
items.description: Security researchers exploited dozens of vulnerabilities in vehicle infotainment systems and EV chargers during the latest Pwn2Own contest at Automotive World 2026.

items.title: Exploited Zero-Day Flaw in Cisco UC Could Affect Millions
items.description: Mass scanning is underway for CVE-2026-20045, which Cisco tagged as critical because successful exploitation could lead to a complete system takeover.

items.title: Malicious AI extensions on VSCode Marketplace steal developer data
items.description: Two malicious extensions in Microsoft's Visual Studio Code (VSCode) Marketplace that were collectively installed 1.5 million times, exfiltrate developer data to China-based servers. [...]

items.title: 20,000 WordPress Sites Affected by Backdoor Vulnerability Allowing Malicious Admin User Creation
items.description: A critical backdoor vulnerability has been discovered in the LA-Studio Element Kit for Elementor, a popular WordPress plugin used by more than 20,000 active sites. This security flaw allows attackers to create administrator accounts without any authentication, putting thousands of websites at risk of complete takeover.
